fed_press.original_observation: Official press releases, monetary policy statements, speeches and testimony.
fed_press.publication_and_availability_clock: Event publication/RSS pubDate; capture first_seen and updated times; statement, transcript and minutes are different events.
fed_press.license_and_redistribution: Federal Reserve site terms; retain provenance and avoid third-party copyrighted attachments without permission.
fed_press.can_infer: Policy-language changes, topic emphasis and uncertainty.
fed_press.cannot_infer: Private FOMC beliefs or automatic hawkish-to-bearish equity mapping.

frbsf_news.original_observation: Economic news tone from 24 US newspapers via Factiva, composition-adjusted trailing weighted average.
frbsf_news.publication_and_availability_clock: DAILY observations but WEEKLY publication. Page updated Oct 26; probe latest row Oct 25. Historical row date is not when row was available.
frbsf_news.license_and_redistribution: Credited reproduction allowed except distribution for private gain under site policy; raw Factiva articles not licensed by index download.
frbsf_news.cannot_infer: Intraday pulse, full market consensus or raw article availability.

cboe_vix.original_observation: Option-price-derived expected 30-day SPX volatility index; daily historical OHLC.
cboe_vix.publication_and_availability_clock: Market index time vs EOD file publication/receipt separate; updated daily, exact EOD upload SLA not verified.
cboe_vix.license_and_redistribution: Public download not broad derived-product/non-display/redistribution license; confirm intended automated/commercial use with Cboe policies.
cboe_vix.can_infer: Market price of near-term variance exposure.
cboe_vix.cannot_infer: Physical crash probability, emotion score or expected direction.

wikimedia_attention.original_observation: Per-article page requests with project/access/agent filters; user filter excludes identified automation.
wikimedia_attention.publication_and_availability_clock: Daily bin closes UTC; usually loaded in hours, sometimes >=24h. 404 may mean zero OR not loaded.
wikimedia_attention.license_and_redistribution: Analytics data CC0 1.0; honor API rate/stability policy.
wikimedia_attention.cannot_infer: Direction or fear from raw pageviews; missing=zero before watermark validated.
